requirements.definition: For an available real kind, SELECTED_REAL_KIND returns a kind whose PRECISION, RANGE, and RADIX meet the requested criteria.

pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-available-kind-criter: Use P=PRECISION(0.0), R=RANGE(0.0), B=RADIX(0.0), K=SELECTED_REAL_KIND(P,R,B), declare REAL(KIND=K), assert K>0, PRECISION(value)>=P, RANGE(value)>=R, and RADIX(value)==B; mutate B to -1 for the unsupported-radix facet.

requirements.title: SELECTED_REAL_KIND unavailable requests return distinct negative codes
requirements.definition: Unavailable real-kind requests return -1 for unmet precision only, -2 for unmet exponent range only, -3 for neither precision nor range met, -4 for precision and range each available but not together, and -5 for no real type with the requested radix.

pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-unmet-precision-minus: Use SELECTED_REAL_KIND(P=HUGE(0)) and assert result -1 under the packet's explicit HUGE(0) precision/range assumption; mutate P to PRECISION(0.0).
pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-unmet-range-minus-two: Use SELECTED_REAL_KIND(R=HUGE(0)) and assert result -2 under the packet's explicit HUGE(0) precision/range assumption; mutate R to RANGE(0.0).
pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-unmet-precision-and-r: Use SELECTED_REAL_KIND(P=HUGE(0),R=HUGE(0)) and assert result -3 under the packet's explicit HUGE(0) precision/range assumption; mutate one argument to zero.
pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-separate-precision-ra: No portable oracle exists for -4: the branch requires separate real kinds satisfying precision and range criteria but no single kind satisfying both, and a program cannot exclude an unnamed kind that satisfies both.
pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-unsupported-radix-min: Use RADIX=-1 and assert SELECTED_REAL_KIND(RADIX=-1)==-5 with a companion supported-radix call returning positive; mutate RADIX to RADIX(0.0).

requirements.title: SELECTED_REAL_KIND applies smallest precision and kind tie rules
requirements.definition: Among multiple real kind values meeting the criteria, SELECTED_REAL_KIND returns the one with smallest decimal precision and then the smallest kind value.

pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-smallest-decimal-prec: Let K1=SELECTED_REAL_KIND(P=PRECISION(0.0)) and K2=SELECTED_REAL_KIND(P=PRECISION(0.0D0)); declare REAL(KIND=K1) and REAL(KIND=K2) variables, assert PRECISION of each selected kind equals the corresponding requested precision, and mutate each requested precision upward by one.
pending.SELECTED_REAL_KIND-smallest-kind-value-t: No portable oracle exists for the final smallest-kind-value tiebreak because the complete numeric kind inventory and duplicate-precision kind values are processor properties.

accounting.rationale: Result value paragraph mixes absent-argument requirements with explicit latitude for absent RADIX.
The standard states that absent RADIX imposes no radix requirement.
Example paragraph is illustrative and assumes a processor-specific real approximation method inventory.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.178-16.9.184: SCALE, SCAN, SELECTED_CHAR_KIND, SELECTED_INT_KIND, SELECTED_LOGICAL_KIND, SELECTED_REAL_KIND and SET_EXPONENT (batch205). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; kind-selection negative codes and the smallest-precision rule are planned through portable relations, while exact kind values and the kind-value tiebreak remain no-oracle.
